evidence: The surface morphology of the films was studied with scanning electron microscopy, SEM (Leo 1550 Gemini), and film surface contamination was examined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, XPS (Perkin Elmer Phi 5500). The diffraction data for the non-textured films deposited on SiO2 were collected with the grazing incidence technique (38 angle of incidence ) by using a non-focusing geometry (Siemens D5000, equipped with an X-ray mirror and parallel-plate collimator). The film composition was calculated from sensitivity factors and XPS peak areas. Film thickness or the amount of deposited material per unit area was measured by energy dispersive X-ray fluorescence spectrometry, XRFS (Spectro X-Lab 2000).
